recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12409 unless Pharmacy reopens the later responsibleParty decision.
issue_request: FHIR-12409 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Pharmacy request for MedicationDispense.substitution. The final resolution kept MedicationDispense.substitution at 0..1, added the definition clarification that if nothing is specified substitution was not done, added wasSubstituted 1..1, kept type 0..1 and reason 0..*, and initially set responsibleParty 0..* as a Practitioner reference.
initial_application: The Jira-applied historical commit 9b846c6688da05aa008a4a62c94ebded5f73e499 changed the MedicationDispense spreadsheet source to add the requested clarification and wasSubstituted child, adjust type to 0..1, keep reason 0..*, and set responsibleParty to 0..* Reference(Practitioner). Current XML source retains the substantive FHIR-12409 structure and wording.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Later published Pharmacy issues intentionally changed the one apparent mismatch with the seed: FHIR-19702 added PractitionerRole to responsibleParty, and FHIR-19697 changed responsibleParty from 0..* to 0..1 and added Organization because multiple responsible parties did not make sense.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reverting responsibleParty to the original FHIR-12409 0..* cardinality would conflict with the later final FHIR-19697 decision, while the rest of the current source already matches the seed change.
